phases.phase: P11 - DL extension: canonical vision split & manifest
phases.notes: Champion frozen (RMSE $103,802.8 / R2 0.9205). Canonical 1,755 train / 434 val image-covered split; no duplicates, no overlap, image alignment validated.

phases.phase: P12 - DL extension: Experiment A (trainable head) + B (layer4 fine-tune)
phases.notes: A1 (price, R2 0.099) and A2 (log-price, R2 0.113) on frozen ResNet18; B partial layer4 fine-tune R2 0.296. Decision gate fired Case 1 (STOP): training a visual head did not approach the tabular control (E4 R2 0.872). Parallel representation checks were also executed and recorded in P13: E6 (tabular + DINOv2-vits14 embeddings, R2 0.9117 vs 0.9203) and PCA-ablated embeddings (best tabular variant 0.8634 vs 0.8721) — mirrors of the same frozen-embedding negative result.

phases.phase: P13 - DL extension: fair evaluation, final table, conclusion
phases.notes: All DL rows on the SAME 434 image-covered val (E4 0.872 / E5 0.844 / A1 0.099 / A2 0.113 / B 0.296). Outcome A: task-specific visual learning adds no measurable value; XGBoost remains champion; vision model is archived as research evidence only and is not exposed in the production app.

champion.selection_rationale: Chosen over CatBoost (random R2 0.9209) because it generalises decisively better out-of-time (0.893 vs 0.881) and spatially (0.809 vs 0.598).
